evidence: Modifies network reporting logic in getnodeaddresses and getrawaddrman in src/rpc/net.cpp.
rationale: The PR fixes an RPC inconsistency where 'getaddrmaninfo counts it under ipv6; getnodeaddresses 0 "ipv6" doesn't return it; getnodeaddresses 0 "ipv4" does return it, labelled ipv4.' Aligning these outputs improves interface correctness for callers filtering peer addresses by network.
